## Ratio and water

Use a ratio of 1:16, for example 15 grams of coffee to 250 grams of water. Water just off the boil, around 93 to 96 degrees Celsius, works for most light and medium roasts.

## The bloom

Start with a bloom: pour about twice the coffee's weight in water, around 30 grams, and wait 30 to 45 seconds. Freshly roasted coffee releases carbon dioxide during the bloom, and letting it escape gives a more even extraction.

## Total time

The whole brew should finish in about three minutes. If it drains much faster, grind finer.
